'''Qumi''' is a female Pioneer Association NPC in {{Location|Mt. Firmament}}. She can be found with Fangdong, outside of town.

==Quests and Events==
{{Quests and Events}}

==Dialogue==
:'''Qumi:''' Let's agree we want safety over adventure on this trip.
:'''Qumi:''' I have too little information on Mt. Firmament, so let's focus on scouting this time.
:'''Fangdong:''' You're the expert, so of course I'll follow you.
:'''Fangdong:''' But, I'm not going to skip any nice scenery we come across, either.
:'''Fangdong:''' The two of us are among the first to sign up for a visit to Mt. Firmament. I've worked hard for a long time to get us this opportunity.
:'''Fangdong:''' The magazine has saved a spot for us, so we've got to offer something unique.
:'''Qumi:''' Worry not, I'll make decisions accordingly.
:'''Qumi:''' Since we're traveling together, I'm responsible for your safety.
